name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban)
description: Credit-linked subsidy and affordable housing support for urban poor/EWS/LIG/MIG to own a pucca house.
benefits: Interest subsidy on home loan (CLSS) and support for house construction.
eligibility: Urban households in EWS/LIG/MIG categories with no pucca house; income and property criteria apply.
processing_time: Verification and sanction per state/ULB cycle.
application_mode: Online (pmaymis.gov.in) and via urban local bodies
office_locator: Urban Local Bodies / State Nodal Agencies.
